title: Recruitment platform V1 delivery via vertical slices (agent-native, TDD/BDD, harness)
description: Master execution epic derived from docs/PLAN_IMPLEMENTATION_RECRUITMENT_PLATFORM_V1.md. This epic enforces vertical slice delivery (VS-0..VS-5), mandatory BDD/TDD gates, UI-to-agent action parity, and harness-based regression controls. All child beads must be self-contained and include acceptance criteria, implementation scope, and verification strategy.
design: Master orchestration epic. Preserve full plan context inside child issues. Enforce vertical slice progression, BDD-first, TDD RED->GREEN evidence, parity checks, and harness regression gates before release.
acceptance_criteria: All VS-0..VS-5 beads closed; parity matrix complete; harness thresholds met; release rollback rehearsal completed.

title: VS-0 walking skeleton: auth/session + source create/read + assistant status read
description: Deliver the first thin vertical slice across DB, backend, UI, and agent tooling. Scope: minimal session path, source config create/read, assistant read-only source status action. Must prove end-to-end operability and seed architecture conventions for later slices.
design: Walking skeleton proving end-to-end architecture. Must include agent-readable source status and parity assertions from day 1.
acceptance_criteria: BDD scenario for source create/read passes via UI and agent; RED->GREEN evidence captured; parity assertions pass.

title: VS-0 test bead: acceptance + integration + parity tests
description: Implement complete test suite for VS-0 including BDD acceptance, integration tests for source create/read, and UI-agent parity checks with detailed logs.
design: Acceptance/integration/parity suite for VS-0 with clear logs and failure diagnostics.
acceptance_criteria: All VS-0 tests pass in CI with readable diagnostics.

title: Harness evaluation framework and CI regression gating
description: Create harness/ scenario pack and runner for recruiter/admin flows. Track correctness, side effects, and tool-trace quality. Enforce no critical regressions as release signal.
design: Create harness runner and scenario catalog for recruiter/admin flows. Score correctness, side effects, and trace quality. Gate on no P0 regressions.
acceptance_criteria: Harness scenarios run in CI; thresholds enforced; regression reports produced with actionable failure summaries.

title: Observability and structured trace instrumentation for agent and workflow actions
description: Add correlation IDs, structured logs, trace spans, and metrics for ingestion, grading, matching, assistant tool calls, and harness outcomes. Ensure data supports diagnosis and scoring.
design: Instrument correlation IDs and spans across ingestion, grading, matching, assistant tool calls, and harness runs. Ensure debuggability of partial failures.
acceptance_criteria: All key workflows emit traceable events and metrics; dashboards/alerts cover failure modes in plan.

title: Security, auditability, and PII redaction controls
description: Implement authN baseline, role-gated mutations, PII-safe logging, and immutable audit events for mutating operations across source configs, applications, and assistant-triggered side effects.
design: Enforce authN/authZ baseline, PII-safe logging, immutable audit events, and mutation approval controls. Add security-focused integration tests.
acceptance_criteria: Security tests and audit assertions pass; unauthorized access attempts are blocked and observable.

title: Performance and reliability verification under realistic load
description: Run search latency, ingestion resilience, and concurrent workflow tests. Validate partial-failure behavior and backlog processing expectations.
design: Validate search latency, ingestion resilience, and backlog behavior under load. Report reproducible benchmark methodology and thresholds.
acceptance_criteria: Performance thresholds in plan met; reliability behavior documented and reproducible.

title: Release governance, runbook completion, and rollback rehearsal
description: Finalize production readiness package: runbooks, alert routes, release checklist, and rollback drill with evidence.
design: Production readiness closure: runbooks, alert routing, release checklist, and rollback rehearsal evidence linked to artifacts.
acceptance_criteria: Go/no-go checklist complete with evidence links; rollback drill validated by team.

title: VS-1 ingest and discover jobs: manual run, dedup persistence, searchable jobs list
description: Deliver ingestion-to-discovery slice: trigger source run, persist deduped jobs, render /jobs with filters, and expose equivalent agent operations. Include ops visibility for run outcomes.
design: Manual source run to deduped persistence to searchable catalog. Include ops visibility and parity execution path.
acceptance_criteria: Manual run and job discovery scenarios pass via UI and agent; search baseline and dedup correctness verified.

title: VS-1 test bead: ingestion/dedup/search + parity and logging
description: Implement unit/integration/e2e tests for ingestion run, dedup rules, and search filters; include mirrored agent-path assertions and detailed logs.
design: Validate dedup behavior, run visibility, and search outcomes via UI and agent with deterministic fixtures.
acceptance_criteria: VS-1 test suite passes and catches known fault injections.

title: VS-2 candidate intake and grading: upload resume, extract text, persist structured grade
description: Deliver candidate intake and grading slice end-to-end. Candidate creation, resume upload/extraction, LLM grading, structured persistence, and mirrored agent workflow.
design: Candidate intake and grading with strict schema validation and score bounds. Parity must hold for trigger and review flows.
acceptance_criteria: Candidate intake and grading scenarios pass; score bounds enforced; UI and agent observe identical grade payloads.

title: VS-2 test bead: candidate intake/grading schema and bounds
description: Implement tests for candidate uniqueness, resume extraction, grade schema validation, score range enforcement, and agent parity outcomes.
design: Validate candidate uniqueness, extraction robustness, grading schema validity, and score bounds.
acceptance_criteria: VS-2 tests pass; malformed grading payloads fail safely.

title: VS-3 matching and pipeline: application create, match scoring, stage transitions
description: Deliver matching and application pipeline slice: create application, execute knock-out + weighted matching, show explanations, and allow stage/notes transitions in UI and via agent tools.
design: Application create + deterministic matching + stage transitions with explainability payloads and integrity checks.
acceptance_criteria: Match + transition scenarios pass; deterministic scoring checks pass; parity checks confirm equivalent state mutations.

title: VS-3 test bead: matching determinism and stage transition integrity
description: Implement deterministic matching tests, application uniqueness/deletion guards, stage transition validation, and parity checks for notes/stage updates.
design: Validate matching determinism, transition guards, and referential integrity.
acceptance_criteria: VS-3 tests pass with deterministic score snapshots and transition guards.

title: VS-4 operations and guardrails: dashboard diagnostics, audit logs, confirmation flow
description: Deliver operator confidence slice: full scraper diagnostics, mutating-action audit logs, assistant/tool trace visibility, and explicit confirmation flows for high-impact operations.
design: Operator diagnostics and trust layer: dashboard depth, audit visibility, confirmation controls, and traceability.
acceptance_criteria: Operator diagnostics scenarios pass; audit coverage complete for mutating actions; confirmation requirements enforced.

title: VS-4 test bead: ops dashboard diagnostics, audit events, confirmations
description: Implement tests for run-history visibility, error drill-down, audit emission on mutating actions, and required confirmations for high-impact tools.
design: Validate dashboard diagnostics completeness, audit emission, and high-impact action confirmation behavior.
acceptance_criteria: VS-4 test suite passes and blocks unsafe mutating flows without confirmation.

title: VS-5 hardening and production readiness: performance, accessibility, SLO, rollback
description: Finalize release-hardening slice: performance validation, accessibility pass, reliability checks, runbooks, alerting, and rollback drill.
design: Final quality hardening and release certification: SLO validation, accessibility pass, reliability checks, rollback drill.
acceptance_criteria: SLO tests pass in staging; no P0/P1 defects; rollback rehearsal successful; release checklist complete.

title: VS-5 test bead: SLO verification, accessibility checks, rollback drill assertions
description: Implement and execute final performance/reliability/accessibility/release verification tests with artifacts and logs suitable for go/no-go decisions.
design: Validate final go/no-go checks with artifacts for SLO, accessibility, reliability, and rollback assertions.
acceptance_criteria: VS-5 release verification artifacts generated and approved.

title: Agent-native architecture contract and tool map implementation
description: Implement section 4.4/9.6/9.7 commitments from the plan: capability discovery, explicit completion signaling, shared workspace behavior, and complete UI-to-agent parity mapping. Include missing CRUD endpoints where parity requires them.
design: Implement and test tool contract parity matrix (section 9.6/9.7). Add explicit completion signal and confirmation semantics. Any UI action without agent-equivalent capability fails this bead.
acceptance_criteria: Every in-scope UI action has a mapped and tested agent tool path; complete_task/request_confirmation semantics enforced.

title: BDD suite for vertical slices (Given/When/Then scenarios and product signoff)
description: Author and maintain BDD acceptance scenarios per slice before implementation starts. Scenarios must cover UI and mirrored agent outcomes and be approved at slice kickoff.
design: Author Gherkin scenarios per VS-0..VS-5 before coding. Include mirrored UI and agent scenarios and approval workflow for scenario changes.
acceptance_criteria: All slices have approved BDD scenarios checked into repo and linked to automated acceptance checks.

title: TDD enforcement pipeline (RED/GREEN evidence + policy checks)
description: Implement enforcement that no production change lands without failing tests first for new behavior. Include contributor guidance, PR checklist fields, and CI checks that verify test artifacts and ordering expectations.
design: Enforce test-first policy in contributor workflow and CI. Require RED evidence for new behavior and block merges when absent.
acceptance_criteria: PR workflow captures RED->GREEN evidence; spot-check audits show compliance across VS-0..VS-5.
